'''2014 Alderaan Regionals Peter Huderich DS Court Of The Vile Gangster''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Peter Huderich]] at [[2014 Alderaan Regionals]] (Regionals).

Handwritten Xerox form.

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die]]
* '''Username:''' peterich
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
